parts:
I am implementing a shiny app in which i need to upload a .xlsx file. and I am doing it with a reactive component. But during which I need to merge the sheets of .xlsx file and it takes a bit time. so I need to show a progress bar during this period. For that I thought of using "withProgress".

 b <- reactive({
   fileinput2 <- input$file2
   if (is.null(fileinput2))
     return(NULL)
   #xlfile <- list.files(pattern = "*.xlsx")
   xlfile <- fileinput2$datapath
   wb <- loadWorkbook(xlfile)
   sheet_ct <- wb$getNumberOfSheets()
  # withProgress(message = 'Calculation in progress', detail = 'This may take a while...', value = 0, {
  # b <- rbind(list(lapply(1:sheet_ct, function(x) {
  #      res <- read.xlsx(xlfile, x)
  # })))
   b <- rbind(list(lapply(1:sheet_ct, function(x) { res <- read.xlsx(xlfile, x) withProgress(message = 'Calculation in progress', detail = 'This may take a while...', value = 0, { for (i in 1:sheet_ct) { incProgress(1/sheet_ct) Sys.sleep(0.25) } }) })))
   b <- b [-c(1),]
 })

But it is throwing the following error
unexpected symbol
59:   # })))
60:    b <- rbind(list(lapply(1:sheet_ct, function(x) { res <- read.xlsx(xlfile, x) withProgress

Why withProgress not working here?
